svg.title: Guardium Data Security Center: four tools, one view
svg.desc: Four Guardium tools on one line, feeding one view of your sensitive data: Guardium Data Protection, activity monitoring and compliance automation; Guardium Vulnerability Assessment, which scans your data stores; Guardium DDR, data detection and response; Guardium Cryptography Manager, for your encryption and your keys.
